Replace.Text: 可再生水源向城市提供+6 [ICON_Power] 电力，向6格范围内的其它城市提供+3 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]解锁“电脑”科技后额外+3 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]若所在城市建有电池储能变电所，则额外产出的 [ICON_Power] 电力将不会被消耗，而会直接被转换为 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源储存。

Provides the city +6 [ICON_Power] Power from renewable water sources, also +3 [ICON_Power] Power for other cities within 6 tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +3 [ICON_Power] Power per turn when the Computers technology is researched.[NEWLINE]If a Battery Substation building is present in this city, the extra [ICON_Power] Power bonuses from Technology will be granted as [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges instead.

每回合可自动转换任意数量的 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源，为6单元格内需要 [ICON_PowerInsufficient] 电力补充的城市供电，转化比率为：[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1点 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源 [ICON_PowerRight] 1点 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]不会向大气排放二氧化碳。[NEWLINE]该建筑的 [ICON_Production] 生产力加成将延伸到6单元格内所有尚未从任何发电厂建筑中获得加成的城市。

Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges [ICON_PowerRight] 1 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]No CO2 into the atmosphere[NEWLINE]Its [ICON_Production] Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.

解锁建造者建造地热发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每回合从可再生地热能中提供+2 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若建在地热裂缝或沼泽（生物质能）上则每回合可额外+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+2 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若与其它地热发电厂相邻则每回合额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]解锁“外星任务”科技后每回合可再额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]若所在城市建有电池储能变电所，则由特殊地形与特定科技解锁而额外产出的 [ICON_Power] 电力将不会被消耗，而会直接被转换为 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源储存。[NEWLINE]必须建在地热裂缝，火山土，或沼泽之上。

Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Geothermal Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn from renewable geothermal sources.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if built on a Geothermal Fissure or Marsh (biomass energy).[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if it is adjacent to another Geothermal Plant.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn when the Offworld Mission technology is researched.[NEWLINE]If a Battery Substatio buildingn is present in this city, the extra [ICON_Power] Power bonuses from Terrain and Technology will be granted as [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges instead.[NEWLINE]Must be built on a Geothermal Fissure, Marsh, or Volcanic Soil.

解锁建造者建造太阳能发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每回合从可再生太阳能中提供+2 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若建在沙漠地形上则每回合可额外+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若与其它太阳能发电厂相邻则每回合额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]解锁“预报系统”科技后每回合可再额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]若所在城市建有电池储能变电所，则由特殊地形与特定科技解锁而额外产出的 [ICON_Power] 电力将不会被消耗，而会直接被转换为 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源储存。[NEWLINE]必须建在平坦地形上。[NEWLINE]需要解锁“高级能量电池”科技后才能建在冻土和雪地地形上。

Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Solar Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn from renewable solar sources.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if built on Desert.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if it is adjacent to another Solar Farm.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn when the Predictive Systems technology is reseached.[NEWLINE]If a Battery Substatio buildingn is present in this city, the extra [ICON_Power] Power bonuses from Terrain and Technology will be granted as [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges instead.[NEWLINE]Must be built on flat terrain.[NEWLINE]Requires the Advanced Power Cells technology to be built on Tundra or Snow terrain.

解锁建造者建造风力发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每回合从可再生风能中提供+2 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若建在靠近海岸的单元格上则每回合可额外+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若与其它风力发电厂相邻则每回合额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]解锁“复合材料”科技后每回合可再额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]若所在城市建有电池储能变电所，则由特殊地形与特定科技解锁而额外产出的 [ICON_Power] 电力将不会被消耗，而会直接被转换为 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源储存。[NEWLINE]必须建在丘陵地貌上。

Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn from renewable wind sources.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if built adjacent to coast.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if it is adjacent to another Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn when the Composites technology is researched.[NEWLINE]If a Battery Substatio buildingn is present in this city, the extra [ICON_Power] Power bonuses from Terrain and Technology will be granted as [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges instead.[NEWLINE]Must be built on Hills terrain.

解锁建造者建造离岸风力发电厂的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每回合从可再生风能中提供+2 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若建在海洋地形上则每回合可额外+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]若与其它离岸风力发电厂相邻则每回合额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]解锁“预报系统”科技后每回合可再额外+1 [ICON_Power] 电力。[NEWLINE]若所在城市建有电池储能变电所，则由特殊地形与特定科技解锁而额外产出的 [ICON_Power] 电力将不会被消耗，而会直接被转换为 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源储存。[NEWLINE]必须建在海岸、湖泊或海洋地形上。[NEWLINE]解锁“海洋家园”科技后才能建在海洋地形上。

Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn from renewable wind sources.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if built on Ocean.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn if it is adjacent to another Offshore Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Extra +1 [ICON_Power] Power per turn when the Predictive Systems technology is reseached.[NEWLINE]If a Battery Substatio buildingn is present in this city, the extra [ICON_Power] Power bonuses from Terrain and Technology will be granted as [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] Renewable Battery Charges instead.[NEWLINE]Must be built on Coast, Lake, or Ocean terrain.[NEWLINE]Requires the Seasteads technology to be built on Ocean terrain.
城市内所有离岸风力发电厂、太阳能发电厂、风力发电厂、地热发电厂及水电站坝均获得+1 [ICON_POWER] 电力、+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币，产出+1 [ICON_RESOURCE_JNR_BATTERY_CHARGE] 可再生能源。
